_instructions: Copy this file to store_config.json and fill in your store details. Do not commit store_config.json — it contains sensitive store information.

store.name: Your Store Name
store.description: One sentence: what do you sell, to whom, at what price point

baseline_metrics._note: Fill in what you know. Leave unknown fields as null.

channels._note: Approximate revenue split by channel. Should sum to 100.

tools._note: List tools/apps connected to your store. This helps the agent know what data is available.

known_issues._note: Optional. List anything you already know is broken or underperforming. The agent will verify and add evidence.

audit_scope._note: Which audits to run. Set to false to skip. All default to true.

constraints._note: Context that affects what recommendations are feasible.
